# Cafazzini

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Online retailer of Italian coffee on Shopify, founded in 2008. Sells ground coffee, coffee beans, capsules, ESE pods, hot chocolate and espresso accessories. Delivers within the UK and offers local collection.
